umf.visual.title: Deployment
umf.visual.question: Where does each part of DepositMatch run?

nodes.label: CloudFront
nodes.detail:
Web App (shared configuration across CloudFront and S3 Web App)

Infrastructure: S3 static hosting behind CloudFront, us-east-1

Instances: 1 distribution

Scaling: CDN-managed

Backup / Recovery: Versioned S3 bucket; redeploy from CI

nodes.label: S3 Web App
nodes.detail:
Web App (shared configuration across CloudFront and S3 Web App)

Infrastructure: S3 static hosting behind CloudFront, us-east-1

Instances: 1 distribution

Scaling: CDN-managed

Backup / Recovery: Versioned S3 bucket; redeploy from CI

nodes.label: ECS API Task A
nodes.detail:
API Service (service-level configuration shared by API Task A and API Task B)

Infrastructure: ECS Fargate service behind Application Load Balancer, us-east-1

Instances: 2 tasks minimum

Scaling: CPU > 60% for 5 minutes or p95 import latency > 3 seconds

Backup / Recovery: Rolling deploy; previous task definition retained

nodes.label: ECS API Task B
nodes.detail:
API Service (service-level configuration shared by API Task A and API Task B)

Infrastructure: ECS Fargate service behind Application Load Balancer, us-east-1

Instances: 2 tasks minimum

Scaling: CPU > 60% for 5 minutes or p95 import latency > 3 seconds

Backup / Recovery: Rolling deploy; previous task definition retained

nodes.label: ECS Matching Worker
nodes.detail:
Matching Worker

Infrastructure: ECS Fargate service, us-east-1

Instances: 1 task minimum

Scaling: Job backlog > 100 for 5 minutes

Backup / Recovery: Restart failed task; jobs remain in PostgreSQL

nodes.label: RDS PostgreSQL 16 Multi-AZ
nodes.detail:
Database

Infrastructure: Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 16, Multi-AZ

Instances: 1 primary, 1 standby

Scaling: Vertical scaling by planned maintenance

Backup / Recovery: PITR enabled; 15-minute RPO; 4-hour RTO

nodes.label: S3 Source Files
nodes.detail:
Source File Store

Infrastructure: S3 bucket with SSE-KMS and versioning

Instances: Regional service

Scaling: S3-managed

Backup / Recovery: Versioning and lifecycle retention

omissions: The example names no zones; tiers are each part's depth from the browser.
